title: 第23章 牛督公第24章 七窍九窍
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: “醒了？”
迷迷糊糊的时候，李叶青总觉得有些不对，梦中，好像有一个人一双眼睛一直在注视着他。
只是等他去寻找那视线的来源时，却怎么也找不到
“唔，做噩梦了”
就在他这么想的时候，一道阴恻恻的声音响起。
李叶青的心脏猛地一缩，几乎要跳出胸腔！
睡意瞬间被驱散得无影无踪。
他霍然坐起，目光死死盯向窗边书桌的方向。
晨光中，一个身影轮廓分明地坐在那里。
借着窗外透进的微弱月光，能看清他身着代表极高身份的玄色斗牛服，两鬓斑白，面容在阴影中看不真切，但那股如山岳般沉重的压迫感，已弥漫了整个狭小的空间。
他手中正随意地翻动着李叶青放在桌上的《黄庭经》，动作从容，仿佛此地的主人。
李叶青认不出对方，不过可以确定是一个太监，身份地位修为都极高。
他是谁？怎么会在这里？什么时候来的？他看了多久？
无数念头如同惊雷在李叶青脑海中炸开，让他头皮发麻。
他强迫自己迅速冷静下来，压下翻腾的气血和惊惧，动作却不敢有丝毫迟疑，穿戴好衣服，躬身行礼。
“小人见过老祖宗。”
虽然不知道是哪一位，但总归应该是其中一位，叫老祖宗错不了。
“先洗漱。”
老祖宗神色不变，手指轻轻一点道。
随即李叶青心中长舒一口气，开始像平时一样梳洗。
甚至趁着这个时间做了一份简易的早饭，小米粥、咸菜配油饼。
然后恭恭敬敬地将食物端到老祖宗面前，香味缭绕着对方的鼻尖，他这才放下手中的《黄庭经》，打量了一眼面前的早饭。
笑着虚点了一下李叶青。
“小家伙倒是会享受，小米粥配油饼，神仙也不换啊。”
言罢，他也不客气，自顾自拿起筷子便吃了起来。
只见他进食速度不快，一口油饼，一口咸菜，再啜一口热粥，咀嚼得极为仔细认真，动作间透着一丝不苟的仪态，仿佛在进行某种古老的仪式。
约莫一刻钟后，老者放下筷子，用一方素净的手帕轻轻擦了擦嘴角。
李叶青也连忙放下碗筷，垂手恭立，心知真正的谈话，此刻才刚刚开始。
“最近在读《黄庭经》？”
“乱读而已。”
content_en:
"Are you awake?"
When he was in a daze, Li Yeqing always felt that something was wrong. In his dream, there seemed to be someone watching him with his eyes.
But when he looked for the source of that sight, he couldn't find it.
"Well, I had a nightmare."
Just as he was thinking this, a gloomy voice sounded.
Li Yeqing's heart suddenly shrank and almost jumped out of his chest!
The sleepiness was instantly driven away without a trace.
He sat up suddenly and stared in the direction of the desk by the window.
In the morning light, a figure sat there with a clear outline.
Through the faint moonlight coming in from the window, one could clearly see that he was wearing a black bullfighting uniform that represented a very high status. His temples were gray, and his face could not be seen clearly in the shadow, but the oppressive feeling as heavy as a mountain had filled the entire small space.
In his hand, he was casually flipping through the "Huang Ting Jing" that Li Yeqing had placed on the table, moving calmly, as if he were the owner of this place.
Li Yeqing couldn't recognize the other party, but he was definitely a eunuch with a very high status and cultivation level.
who is he? Why are you here? When did you come? How long had he been watching?
Countless thoughts exploded in Li Yeqing's mind like thunder, making his scalp numb.
He forced himself to calm down quickly, suppressing the boiling blood and fear, but without any hesitation in his movements, he put on his clothes and bowed to salute.
"The villain has met our ancestors."
Although I don’t know which one it is, it must be one of them. The ancestor can’t be wrong.
"Wash up first."
The ancestor's expression remained unchanged, and he said lightly with his finger.
"Yes."
Then Li Yeqing breathed a sigh of relief and began to wash up as usual.
I even took this time to make a simple breakfast of millet porridge, pickles and fried pancakes.
Then he respectfully brought the food to the ancestor, and the fragrance lingered on the tip of his nose. Then he put down the "Huang Ting Jing" in his hand and took a look at the breakfast in front of him.
He smiled and nodded at Li Yeqing.
"The little one will enjoy it. Millet porridge and fried pancakes, gods won't change it."
After saying that, he was not polite, picked up his chopsticks and started eating.
I saw that he was eating slowly, taking a mouthful of oil cakes, a mouthful of pickles, and a sip of hot porridge. He chewed very carefully, with a meticulous manner in his movements, as if he was performing some ancient ritual.
About a quarter of an hour later, the old man put down his chopsticks and gently wiped the corners of his mouth with a plain handkerchief.
Li Yeqing also quickly put down his bowls and chopsticks, lowered his hands and stood respectfully, knowing that the real conversation had just begun at this moment.
"Have you been reading "Huang Ting Jing" recently?"
"Just reading it randomly."
